history_policy: publish one sanitized snapshot without private source history

transformations.credentials: provider credentials and workstation paths remain redacted; task-local emulator credentials are retained

task14.trajectory_policy: agent and verifier evidence preserved byte-for-byte; destination-local result and lock metadata normalized

historical_result_policy: retain stored result task_checksum values as historical run identifiers
delivered_hash_policy: record hashes of the delivered anonymized task packages in frozen-cohort.json
